meta.title: Battery demand & end-of-life materials, 2020-2050

units.materials: Mt per year (key metals: lithium LCE, nickel, cobalt, copper, graphite)
units.plant: Baiji Inside™ Certified dual-line (LFP/NCM): 40 ktpa EoL feedstock -> 10 ktpa battery-grade materials at 4:1 mass balance, 2025 US$100M; tCO2e Certificates maintained on locked ECRU Registry

meta.disclaimer: Illustrative modelled figures for discussion. Not investment advice. Re-verify against current market data before external use.

consensus.label: Analyst consensus
consensus.description: Flat extrapolation; has under-reported battery demand every year since 2020.

accelerated_eol.label: Accelerated EoL
accelerated_eol.description: Larger packs (marine/heavy-truck megapacks), data-centre volumes at deep DoD, deeper cycle rates, harsher asset use, 3C & small-format fleet (phones, laptops, tools, warehouse robots, forklifts). 2030-2040 is the steep section of the S-curve: 7 -> 23 TWh, not linear.

doubling_down.label: Doubling Down
doubling_down.description: All accelerated-EoL drivers plus the 15th FYP circular economy rolling into a 16th FYP fast-track: 50% of battery materials from recovery by 2035. Applied energy of coal, oil and gas replaced; diesel out.

derived_rules.plants_operating: eol_feedstock_TWh * 1000 / 6.7 (each 40 ktpa EoL plant processes ~6.7 GWh of EoL batteries p.a. at ~6 kt/GWh)

event_markers.2026: Hormuz factor: diesel economics broken; illustrative global spikes EV +38%, PV +30%, BESS +55%, diesel gensets -38% vs 2025

derived_rules.battery_grade_output: plants * 10,000 tpa at 4:1 mass balance (40 kt EoL -> 10 kt battery-grade)

mine_supply_millions_t.note: Key metals (Li LCE, Ni, Co, Cu, graphite) tonnes from existing + committed mines; demand exceeds this even with recovery — structural deficit from 2030
intervention_levers: Recovery fast-track: 50% of materials from recovery by 2035 (16th FYP path)
Alternative storage in the stationary layer: Na-ion, vanadium flow, pumped hydro, compressed air — freeing lithium/LFP for transport and mobility
Hydrogen / metal-hydride storage for the seasonal layer after 2035 (slower ramp)
New mine supply: 10-15 year lead times the deficit will price in

pumped_hydro.constraint: geography + 5-8 year civil build; absorbs bulk/weekly shifting

vanadium_flow.status: world-first GWh-scale VFB entered operation Jan 2026, 5h daily cycling co-located with 1 GW solar
vanadium_flow.leader: Rongke Power ~40-50% of global operating VFB fleet
vanadium_flow.constraint: vanadium supply (China ~60% of world output, steel-slag linked); electrolyte leasing mitigates

compressed_air.status: world's largest CAES online Jan 2026, 71% efficiency

metal_hydride_hydrogen.status: niche (materials handling, demonstration); grid role seasonal after 2035
metal_hydride_hydrogen.constraint: cost per kWh vs batteries at <=24h duration; high-temp Mg hydrides
